actual_hs_list: 130232 (guar gum / mucilages & thickeners derived from guar seed — guar gum powder, guar refined splits, fast hydration guar gum powder)
130232 or 130239 (cassia gum powder — galactomannan from Cassia tora seed; classification depends on whether treated as guar-gum-type mucilage or other vegetable mucilage)
121190 (Cassia tora seed / splits / meal — raw & semi-processed plant material, not elsewhere specified)
230800 or 121300 (guar meal / fodder — guar korma/churi as feed ingredient or fodder)
091099 — declared; NOT corroborated by any product on the site (no spice/seasoning line found)
product_summary: Website avlasthydrocolloids.com (fetched, live) lists: Cassia Gum line — Cassia Tora Seed, Cassia Tora Splits, Cassia Tora Meal, Cassia Gum Powder; Guar Gum line — Guar Meal (Fodder), Guar Refined Splits, Guar Gum Powder, Fast Hydration Guar Gum Powder. Self-described as 'manufacturer, processor, exporter & supplier of cassia gum powder and guar gum powder', plant at 618, G.I.D.C. Estate, Phase-IV, Vatva, Ahmedabad-382445, Gujarat; in the hydrocolloids business since 2006; certifications claimed: Kosher, Halal, FSSC 22000:2013. No spice, essential-oil, resin, oleoresin or botanical-extract product appears anywhere in the catalogue.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — site claims own processing/manufacturing facility plus trading of raw seed/splits/meal; no independent evidence of plant ownership reviewed (out of scope).
comment: HS 130190 (declared) is a plausible but imprecise fit: guar gum and cassia gum are galactomannan mucilages, which normally sit under 1302.32 (guar) / 1302.39 (other mucilages & thickeners), not the residual 1301.90 (gums, resins, balsams of vegetable origin). So the hydrocolloid part is 'partial' — right chapter, likely wrong subheading; recommend correcting to 130232 for guar gum powder and 130232/130239 for cassia gum powder. HS 091099 (declared) is NOT corroborated: 0910 covers ginger, saffron, turmeric, thyme, bay leaves, curry and other spices — nothing in the catalogue matches, so this line is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' and should be dropped unless a spice line exists off-site. Missing from the declaration: the entire raw-material/feed side of the business — Cassia tora seed, splits and meal (121190) and Guar Meal/Fodder (230800/121300), which are a material share of the listed range. Industry label 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is a misclassification: the company is a hydrocolloid / industrial gum and agro-processing supplier (food-grade additives, but also oil-drilling, paper, textile and feed applications), not an FMCG food producer. Trader signs: sells raw seed, splits and fodder alongside processed powders, and markets itself as 'supplier' as well as manufacturer — consistent with a manufacturer-trader mix. All product data here comes from the company's own website only; no customs line was available to this researcher, so every HS mapping above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at the shipment level. Per project rules the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground — company retained, codes to be corrected.
